title: Pure Barrier Statue
summary: An anti-meta stun build centered on Barrier Statue of the Heavens and Barrier Statue of the Abyss, paired with Level 4 floodgate monsters, battle-winning Equip Spells, and defensive Traps. Each Barrier Statue locks both players out of Special Summoning monsters of all Attributes except its own, shutting down modern combo decks off a single Normal Summon.

summary.title: Starters & Floodgate Monsters
points: Barrier Statue of the Heavens prevents both players from Special Summoning any monsters except LIGHT monsters, while Barrier Statue of the Abyss prevents Special Summoning any monsters except DARK monsters.
Inspector Boarder restricts how many monster effects can be activated each turn to the number of Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, Pendulum, and Link monster types currently on the field.
Thunder King Rai-Oh stops both players from adding cards from the Deck to the hand except by drawing and sends itself from the field to the GY to negate an inherent Special Summon.
Denko Sekka locks both players out of Setting Spells/Traps or activating Set Spell/Trap Cards while you control no Set Spells/Traps.

summary.title: Opening: Barrier Statue + Moon Mirror Shield
steps: Normal Summon Barrier Statue of the Heavens or Barrier Statue of the Abyss to immediately cut off non-LIGHT or non-DARK Special Summons.
Equip the Barrier Statue with Moon Mirror Shield or Mage Power so the opponent cannot clear its 1000 base ATK with a Normal Summoned monster.
Set Safe Zone and Solemn Judgment in the backrow to protect the Statue and your Equip Spells from removal and board wipes.

summary.title: Bosses & Control: Stat Scaling & Protection
summary.text: Because every Barrier Statue has only 1000 ATK and 1000 DEF, the deck's primary goal is making them unbeatable in battle. Moon Mirror Shield sets the equipped monster's ATK and DEF to 100 higher than any monster it battles during damage calculation, guaranteeing the Statue wins every combat, and recycles itself to the top or bottom of the Deck for 500 LP if sent to the GY. Alongside a full backrow, Mage Power boosts a Barrier Statue by 500 ATK/DEF for each Spell/Trap you control, turning it into a 3500 ATK floodgate.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Safe Zone continuously makes a face-up Attack Position Barrier Statue untargetable and indestructible by battle or opponent's card effects.
Solemn Judgment pays half your LP to negate any Summon or Spell/Trap activation such as Harpie's Feather Duster or Lightning Storm that threatens your backrow.
Generic handtraps and staple Spells from the fill packages provide extra disruption when going second.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Barrier Statue of the Stormwinds is Forbidden in the TCG, and the remaining elemental Statues are omitted in favor of the LIGHT and DARK pair, which synergize cleanly with Thunder King Rai-Oh, Inspector Boarder, and Denko Sekka.

allow.Inspector Boarder: Level 4 Machine stun monster that restricts monster effect activations based on monster card types on the field.
allow.Thunder King Rai-Oh: Level 4 Thunder stun partner that prevents adding cards from Deck to hand and sends itself to negate a Special Summon.
allow.Denko Sekka: Level 4 Thunder stun partner that prevents setting Spells/Traps or activating Set Spell/Trap Cards.
allow.Moon Mirror Shield: Equip Spell that guarantees any Barrier Statue wins every battle by setting its ATK/DEF to the opponent's monster + 100.
allow.Mage Power: Equip Spell that grants up to 2500 ATK/DEF to a Barrier Statue based on the number of Spell/Traps you control.
allow.Safe Zone: Continuous Trap that makes a face-up Barrier Statue untargetable and indestructible by battle or opponent's card effects.
allow.Solemn Judgment: Counter Trap that protects the Barrier Statue and backrow from board wipes like Harpie's Feather Duster or Lightning Storm.
